sections.t: Nothing logged yesterday, and no session was planned since the plan starts today. The last recorded training was a lifting session on 10 Nov.
Week 1, rest day. An easy walk is fine for recovery. This week's runs are 3 km easy on Wednesday and Saturday and a 3.3 km long run on Sunday.
Rest days still get the full 130 g protein and about 1,750 kcal, so do not cut lower. Split protein into 3 to 4 meals of roughly 30 to 40 g each to support tomorrow's Lower A session.
No runs logged since 29 Oct, and the last three ran at 7:16 to 7:38/km, which is faster than easy for you. Keep Wednesday's 3 km at 8:30 to 9:00/km or slower, with walk breaks if needed.
